providers.name: OpenAI Codex
providers.rollback: Before running setup, copy ~/.codex/hooks.json to a safe backup if it exists. The setup command overwrites hooks.json rather than merging with existing hooks. To roll back, restore that backup; without one, remove AgentTrace hooks manually, but previous hooks overwritten by setup cannot be reconstructed.
providers.privacy: Events pass through AgentTrace's normal redaction path; hook visibility is limited to fields emitted by the provider.
known_gaps: The setup command replaces hooks.json; restoring previously configured hooks requires a backup.
The current integration documentation does not claim a Codex session-end hook.
File, command, and error coverage depends on PreToolUse/PostToolUse payloads.
This entry is intentionally marked unverified until a clean-environment versioned verification run is recorded.
